item: Row 378: ten app folders are judged entry by entry by both erasers
refs: PR #2403; R836 R837 R806 R798 R783 R791 (and the coordinator HF token ruling)
key_paths: src/safety/data_scope.py; src/safety/crypto_erase.py; src/safety/uninstall.py; src/static/data-volume.js; src/static/app-backup.js; tests/test_erase_shaped_folders_row378.py; docs/SECURITY.md
summary: models, cache, runtime, leases, wiki_dumps, osm_regions, osm_work, ip_geo, weather_context and osm_borders (data_scope.SHAPED_DIRS) were removed whole in the app's own folder and left whole in a shared one. Now, in both scopes and in both the in-process erase and the uninstall watcher, only first-level entries fitting a shape the app writes go; anything else, a link or a non-regular entry is left and counted (never followed, never named), the folder and the data folder stay, and the result says the erase of the data folder is not complete (R836 Q2). models/ollama and models/huggingface are the app's only while their own first level holds nothing but blobs/manifests or hub/xet/token/stored_tokens (R837), judged again through the handle that walks and removes them; Hugging Face's token files go in the early pass after the keys. The bare cache names are left in a shared folder. The shared-folder notice names the folders removed whole from the code's own list (data_scope.WHOLE_DIRS); two new strings x12, Plan-read.
